# OpenRouter

OpenRouter is a platform that provides a unified API for accessing various large language models (LLMs) from different providers, allowing developers to integrate multiple AI models seamlessly.

Category: Other. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/openrouter/.

## Actions

- **Create Chat Completion** (read-only): Generate a chat-style completion.
- **Create Completion** (read-only): Generate a text completion for a given prompt or set of messages.
- **Get Credits** (read-only): Get the current api credit balance for the authenticated user.
- **Get Generation** (read-only): Retrieve a generation result by its unique id.
- **List Available Models** (read-only): List available models via openrouter api.
- **OpenRouter List Model Endpoints** (read-only): List endpoints for a specific model.
- **OpenRouter List Providers** (read-only): List all ai model providers available through the openrouter api.
